description: NaSm₃Ti₂(SbO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.72 Å. There are three inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.76 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.61 Å. In the third Sm site, Sm is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-44°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.02 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with six SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.00 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-47°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.03 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-47°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.02 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Sm atoms to form ONaSm₃ tetrahedra that share corners with six ONaSm₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaSmSb₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Sm, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSmSb₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Sm and two Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom.
